findings.detail: UK debt rows carry GBP par in the source while the flagged holdings rows have blank principal_amount_usd, so the USD principal conversion is missing.

rationale: FX01 flags non-USD debt principal rows with missing principal_amount_usd. The filing's SOI shows Clearcourse debt with Par denominated in GBP while cost and fair value are presented in USD, so the source establishes a non-USD par value that needs an explicit USD principal_amount_usd conversion. The flagged blank observed value is therefore a real extraction/normalization gap, not a false alarm.
